title: Asymptotic lower bound on a weighted binomial coefficient
statement:
Fix a real number $p$ with $0 < p < 1$ and an integer $q \ge 2$, and let $H_q$ denote the $q$-ary entropy function. Then there is a function $\varepsilon \colon \bbn \to \bbr$ with $\varepsilon(n) = o(n)$ such that, for all sufficiently large $n$,
\[
\binom{n}{\lfloor np \rfloor}\,(q-1)^{pn} \;\ge\; q^{\,H_q(p)\,n \,-\, \varepsilon(n)}.
\]
hypotheses_covered: existence of an error term ε(n) that is o(n) as n → ∞
the inequality holds eventually (for all sufficiently large n)
replaced:
For $0<p<1$ and $q\ge 2$, eventually
\[
\tbinom{n}{\lfloor np\rfloor}(q-1)^{pn}
\;\ge\;
q^{H_q(p)\,n - \varepsilon(n)},
\quad \varepsilon(n) = o(n).
\]
